controls: Both arms have the same code archive, paid prefix, Python and experiment tools. Only Hegel requires an executable hypothesis/research-question manifest.
discovery: No supplied state-model menu, diagnostic label, fitted candidate, or research procedure. Predictors, representations, experiment programs and readouts are provider-authored.
terminal_order: All training stops before terminal labels are generated. Submitted predictor files and their paid training view stay fixed.
failure_policy: Keep all initially registered sources and provider, research and confirmation failures.
scope: Deterministic development controls on 21 public input levels; learning horizon 24. Terminal horizon 48 tests new paths, not different physical objects. This pilot alone establishes neither recursive superiority nor cross-task meta-prior learning.
